Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step (Step 6). After correctly identifying the birthdates (Don McGuire: February 28, 1919 and Nunzio Malasomma: February 4, 1894), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the director with the later birthdate (1919) was "older." In reality, the person with the earlier birthdate (1894) is the older one. The Planner confused the concept of "older" (born earlier) with "younger" or simply compared the years incorrectly, leading to the wrong final answer ("Johnny Concho" instead of "One Minute To Twelve").
